title: Did Early Humans Keep Souvenirs 500,000 Years Ago?
paragraphs: Do you keep old things? Many people keep a small stone or a ticket from a trip.
Scientists in Israel have a new idea. They say early humans did this too, about 500,000 years ago.
They found colourful pebbles in a cave. The stones had no use. People also kept stone tools with fossils inside. The idea is not proven.
